requirement: Rewrite S29a journey script into an assertion harness that fails on broken runtime
assertionSet: manifest version/commit/source_tree equal expected candidate; computed exe sha256 equals manifest.sha256 and expected sha
J1 aliases include configured model; HTTP 200; SSE DONE; marker present; finish stop; stream.requested true
J2 tool_calls present; exact tool_call_id; follow-up HTTP 200; final marker; upstream saw tool_call_id+tool result
exactly three request ids; every HTTP id exists in runtime_observations and runtime_telemetry_records
every persisted observation has matching request/decision/endpoint and provider attempt id; HTTP attempt ids equal DB
three retention capture rows; every capture row joins a capture-* id from retention_records
artifact-store JSON parsed for tool:call index 0 and tool:result index 1 with the same tool_call_id
capture API called for every request; real statuses recorded (all 404 in this run)
state files actually searched for both markers; markerInPersisted true (capture queue WAL + deferred capture SQLite)
kill taskkill, wait for child exit and assert pid gone
restart same state root, new pid, same request ids, observations 200, capture API statuses recorded
stop/read DB again; observation, telemetry and capture id row identity unchanged
stateQueries: retention-state.sqlite: retention_captures joined to retention_records by json.r -> capture id
artifact-store.json: parsed tool call/result boundary JSON objects
state file walk: marker presence in capture-queue.sqlite-wal and deferred-route-captures.sqlite

mutations.name: skip-kill
